working_definition: Akh-GAL4-sorted adult corpora cardiaca cells (Smart-seq2 population), i.e. Akh-producing endocrine cells of the corpus cardiacum.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Peptidergic neuron that secretes the Adipokinetic hormone (Akh). These cells are exclusively found in the corpora cardiaca. They express Akh from late embryos to adult stage (Lee and Park, 2004).

justification: Sample typed from the Akh-GAL4-sorted population; FBbt has no generic 'corpus cardiacum cell' term, and Akh secreting cells are the corpora cardiaca endocrine cells. No adult-specific variant exists.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Endocrine cell of the ring gland.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Broader parent of Akh secreting cell.
